name: @qicable/website-workbench
description: Qicable customer UI and local static preview, using the TradeMax locked frontend dependencies.

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:preview && next dev preview --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3104
scripts.build: npm run prepare:preview && next build preview
scripts.check:export: node --import tsx scripts/check-export.mjs && npm run check:seo
scripts.lint: eslint ui/src preview/app scripts tests eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0
